03. What I Do

Reporting and analysis services

Day to day work. Work I can do for your team.

▦

MIS & Operational Reporting

One report for sales, stock and operations. What happened, where it happened, and what needs attention next. Daily, weekly or monthly. No raw tables.

▤

Sales, Sell-through & Size Availability

MoM and YoY comparisons. Best sellers, slow movers, missing sizes and items due for replenishment.

◔

Stock Ageing & Replenishment

Stock movement and stock ageing. Fill rate and size availability. Gaps flagged early.

◎

GA4 & Conversion Analysis

GA4 and conversion analysis. What visitors do, where they drop off, and what converts.

▣

Live Dashboards & Reporting Tools

Power BI dashboards, SQL, Power Query and VBA. Shopify, Candela Retail and Ginko Retail for reporting.

05. AI in My Reporting

AI helps with the first draft. I check the final number.

I use ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and Claude when I build a report. They help with a first draft. I check the final number.

Where AI helps

First draft of a formula. A messy sheet cleaned up. A long table summed up in plain words.

Where it does not decide

Totals, stock, costs and sell-through. I check those myself in SQL, Excel and Power BI before sending.

What you get

A faster first draft. The same checked final report. No invented figures. No company data in a public tool.

ChatGPTCopilotGeminiClaude

07. Questions, Answered

Frequently asked questions

Straight answers about my work, my platform and how to reach me.

Who is Mirza Noman Ali?

Mirza Muhammad Noman Ali is a data analyst in Lahore, Pakistan. Three years of experience. Retail and ecommerce analytics. A Government of Punjab field programme, the Dastak Program. Foundation administration at Qadir Foundation. Currently at Cougar Knitwear as Data Analyst, Online Officer and Reporting Specialist.

Is the data in the project screenshots real company data?

No. Screenshots and the live project use demo and sample data. Not company data. That is why they are shown clear and in full. Nothing blurred. Open the live project and see the same demo data.

Which tools does Noman use for reporting and dashboards?

SQL for checking and pulling data. Advanced Excel with Power Query, Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, INDEX MATCH and VBA for analysis and report building. Power BI for dashboards. Shopify, Candela Retail and Ginko Retail for reporting. Next.js and React for the Cougar Desk 2.0 dashboard. Plus ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini and Claude for a first draft or a messy sheet cleanup. Always rechecked by me. My education is a Bachelor's in Computer Science (14-year) and a Diploma in Information Technology.

What is MIS reporting, in simple words?

MIS reporting is a short, regular report. It tells a manager what sold, what is in stock, and what needs a decision. No raw tables to read through.
